---
title: "Forecasting Demand"
---

**Guiding question:** How many rides will a station — or the system as a whole — see next month, and how far ahead can we actually trust that forecast?


**What this page will cover (planned):**

- A time-series model of system-wide (and possibly station- or ward-level) demand
- How well it captures the seasonal shape already seen in the Overview
- How far ahead the forecast stays reliable before uncertainty takes over
